interpretation.naiveExpansion: Adding two newly discovered non-tech 2025 candidates increased absolute-positive rate slightly (85.7% -> 88.9%) but reduced excess-win rate materially (85.7% -> 66.7%). More sources alone increased recall but diluted relative quality.
interpretation.sourceQuorum2025: Within the 2025 exploratory window, the three-source research quorum separated the sample extremely well: all six quorum-pass cases beat CSI300, while all three quorum-fail/expanded cases did not. This is promising but post-hoc and small-sample.
interpretation.crossWindowCheck: When the same quorum idea is checked against 2026H1, nearly every selection already had strong source triangulation, yet only 3/6 won. Pooling 2025+2026 raises excess-win rate only from 69.2% to 75.0%. The apparent improvement is modest and statistically fragile.
interpretation.conclusion: Better sources are necessary for broader recall, cleaner company mapping and expectation measurement, but they do not by themselves produce a large robust hit-rate improvement. The dominant remaining errors are timing/absorption, event half-life, benchmark opportunity cost and stale re-underwrite.
